sections.kicker: Prepared for Geist Brewing Co. by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Geist proves its beer is good. It has not yet said why it is Geist.
sections.keep: The can art. POP FICTION is a world no other brewery in Bengaluru has.

pins.area: The site opens on an award ceremony photo with AWARDED GOLD over it
pins.what: Both front doors open with an award, the site and the Instagram bio.
pins.why: Awards prove the beer is good. They do not say why Geist and not every other craft brewery in Bengaluru.
pins.how: Lead with what only Geist stands for and keep the awards as proof under it.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Until it changes, Geist competes on medals, and every brewery that wins one shares them.

pins.what: Instagram has an illustrated world on the cans. The site opens with a stage photo.
pins.why: The two doors look like two different brands, and the most ownable asset is missing from the site.
pins.how: Pick one world and carry it across every surface.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: Someone who loves the cans lands on the site and meets a different brand.

pins.area: The highlights row is a list of city names
pins.what: The first row of the brand world is a distribution map.
pins.why: It tells people where to buy, not why to care.
pins.how: Turn the highlights into the Geist world: the beers, the taprooms, the people behind them.
pins.label: Your highlights
pins.cost: The row people tap first keeps saying nothing about Geist.
